title: Finally.. the wait is over, after more than 13 long days in the making....
author: Spirited_Tie_3473
selftext:
Slough Theft Auto is an entirely unofficial parody project and is in absolutely no way affiliated with, endorsed by, sponsored by, or even vaguely acknowledged by Rockstar Games, Take-Two Interactive, or the Grand Theft Auto franchise.

All trademarks, logos, and intellectual property belong to their respective owners. We are simply here to take the piss.

Any resemblance to Grand Theft Auto is purely intentional, entirely satirical, and hopefully protected by a lawyer who understands what a joke is.

This project was created for entertainment purposes only. No actual cars were stolen during development, although several Greggs sausage rolls remain unaccounted for.

Please don’t sue us. We’re from Slough. We’ve suffered enough.

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body: u/Spirited_Tie_3473 please expand this post with how you used AI during development. It's not enough to say you used AI. Tell us what you did with it. The point of Rule 4 is for promotional posts to give something back by sharing the process and actual development. We're cracking down on posts that only advertise. If you don't update, this may be removed.

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body:
Please see the requirements for posts about commercial games promotion.

**Game Promotion Posts Allowed, with Requirements**

You must discuss your game within the context of how it was developed using AI. Share with the community and give something for the community to talk about in your development experience with AI. A fire and forget video/image with no text, chatGPT bullet list may be removed by mods. If your game is being sold, you MUST apply the "Commercial Self Promotion" flair.
